reply_text:
I replied in Ilse's DM: her dock for Quarrendon Freight Lines pickups is Bay 30. She told me that on 14 Oct, and I checked it against that message in her DM history before answering.

That DM also contains a message from me on 14 Oct that I meant only as my own wrap-up. Only Ilse can see the DM, so nothing reached anyone else.
